metadata.description: WhoisFreaks Sentinel connector infrastructure: Function App, storage, DCE, DCR, custom tables, role assignments.
Microsoft Sentinel / Log Analytics workspace name
Region for Function App, storage, DCE (should match workspace region when possible)
Function App name (must be globally unique)
URL of FunctionApp.zip for WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE. Default is the Azure-Sentinel raw GitHub URL after the PR merges. Override with a SAS URL when testing before merge.
App Service plan SKU. Use B1+ (not Y1) when the resource group blocks Linux Consumption (LinuxDynamicWorkersNotAllowedInResourceGroup).
